code_name: National Building Code of India (NBC) 2016 - Part 8 Building Services & Part 3 General Building Requirements
scope: All Habitable Buildings and Community Shelters

rules.clause: Part 3, Clause 12.2 - Minimum Height of Habitable Rooms
rules.description: Clear height of all habitable rooms from finished floor to lowest point of ceiling or truss must not be less than 2.60 m (2.75 m recommended in hot-humid zones).
rules.remediation: Increase floor-to-ceiling framing height to at least 2.60 m.

rules.category: Minimum Floor Area per Habitable Unit
rules.clause: Part 3, Clause 12.1 - Size of Habitable Rooms
rules.description: Single habitable room must have a minimum carpet area of 9.5 m² with a minimum width of 2.4 m.
rules.remediation: Expand floor footprint or reconfigure modular partition spacing.

rules.clause: Part 8, Section 1, Clause 5 - Natural Ventilation Apertures
rules.description: Total area of exterior openings directly opening into external air must be at least 1/10th of floor area in dry climates and 1/8th (12.5%) in humid climates.
rules.remediation: Enlarge operable fenestration or install ridge / gable ventilation vents.

rules.clause: Part 8, Section 1, Clause 4.3 - Weather Protection Chajja
rules.description: Windows exposed to direct solar radiation or heavy driving rain must have overhangs/chajjas projecting at least 0.45 m beyond the wall face.
rules.remediation: Increase roof eave or window chajja projection to >= 0.45 m.
